color:#047857;">2. color:#7e22ce;">3. Data Source Layer</b> &nbsp;<span style="font-size:12px; color:#9333ea;">Manages interactions with databases, messaging queues, filesystems, and external services</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="25" width="1000" x="100" y="475" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l3_b1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#d8b4fe;strokeWidth=1.5;arcSize=6;" value="<b style="color:#6b21a8;">Relational Databases</b><br><span style="font-size:11px; color:#a855f7;">PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="230" x="105" y="510" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l3_b2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#d8b4fe;strokeWidth=1.5;arcSize=6;" value="<b style="color:#6b21a8;">Repositories &amp; Mappers</b><br><span style="font-size:11px; color:#a855f7;">Data Mapper / Table Gateways</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="230" x="360" y="510" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l3_b3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#d8b4fe;strokeWidth=1.5;arcSize=6;" value="<b style="color:#6b21a8;">Payment &amp; External APIs</b><br><span style="font-size:11px; color:#a855f7;">Stripe, SendGrid, Auth0 clients</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="230" x="615" y="510" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l3_b4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#d8b4fe;strokeWidth=1.5;arcSize=6;" value="<b style="color:#6b21a8;">Message Queues &amp; Events</b><br><span style="font-size:11px; color:#a855f7;">RabbitMQ, Kafka, Pub/Sub</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="230" x="870" y="510" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rule_banner" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef2f2;strokeColor=#ef4444;strokeWidth=1.5;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;arcSize=6;fontSize=12;" value="<b style="color:#b91c1c;">The Invariant of Directionality:</b> <span style="color:#991b1b;">Lower layers NEVER depend on upper layers. The Domain Layer is completely decoupled from HTTP frameworks, request lifecycles, and relational database schemas.</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="1040" x="80" y="620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
